import novamind_api as nm
day0 = 273
cash0 = nm.query("SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),0) a FROM ledger")['rows'][0]['a']
r = nm.query("""SELECT start_day s, effective_price p, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions
  WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY start_day, effective_price""")
cohorts = [[row['s'], row['p'], float(row['n'])] for row in r['rows']]
init_subs = sum(c[2] for c in cohorts)
print(f"@@@ FC39 init active {init_subs:,.0f}  cash0 ${cash0:,.0f}")

def surv(k):
    if k<=0: return 1.0
    if k==1: return 0.10
    if k==2: return 0.72
    return 0.88

ACQ_DAY=4150.0; ACQ_DECAY=0.997
PROMO_FIRST=41.5; NEW_REBILL=47.3
# costs
FIXED_DAY=117500.0          # ads25k+ops58k+cap28k+dev6.5k
COMPUTE_PSD=0.477
ADREV_PSD=0.105
LEAD_PER_ACQ=1.19           # $/new-sub for lead acquisition

def total_active(): return sum(c[2] for c in cohorts if c[2]>0)
cash=cash0; acq=ACQ_DAY
checkpoints={280:'1wk(d280)',301:'4wk(d301)',357:'12wk(d357)',455:'26wk(d455)'}
results={}; wlog=[]; wk_coll=0.0; wk_new=0.0; wk_start=cash
for d in range(day0+1,456):
    bucket=d%30; collected=0.0
    for c in cohorts:
        s,p,n=c
        if n<=0 or s>=d: continue
        if (s%30)!=bucket: continue
        k=(d-s)//30
        if k<=0: continue
        sv=n*surv(k); collected+=sv*p; c[2]=sv
    newbill=acq*PROMO_FIRST
    collected+=newbill
    cohorts.append([d,NEW_REBILL,acq])
    subs=total_active()
    adrev=subs*ADREV_PSD
    lead=acq*LEAD_PER_ACQ
    opex=FIXED_DAY+subs*COMPUTE_PSD+lead
    cash+=collected+adrev-opex
    wk_coll+=collected; wk_new+=newbill
    acq*=ACQ_DECAY
    if d in checkpoints: results[d]=cash
    if (d-day0)%7==0:
        net=cash-wk_start
        wlog.append((d,subs,wk_coll,wk_new,net,cash)); wk_coll=0.0; wk_new=0.0; wk_start=cash
print("\n wkend | subs | collect7d | new7d | survivor7d | net7d | cash")
for d,subs,coll,new,net,csh in wlog[:18]:
    print(f"  d{d}(b{(d-6)%30}-{d%30}): subs={subs:>8,.0f} coll=${coll:>10,.0f} new=${new:>9,.0f} surv=${coll-new:>10,.0f} net=${net:>10,.0f} cash=${csh:>13,.0f}")
print("\n=== FC39 CHECKPOINTS (from d273 cash ${:,.0f}) ===".format(cash0))
for d in sorted(checkpoints):
    print(f"  {checkpoints[d]}: ${results[d]:,.0f}   (delta ${results[d]-cash0:+,.0f})")

import novamind_api as nm
DAY=273
print("@@@ FC39 DIAG @@@")
# Subscribed subs by maturity band (k = rebills completed) and bucket
r = nm.query("""SELECT billing_day_mod30 b, 
  CASE WHEN start_day>=244 THEN 0 WHEN start_day>=214 THEN 1 WHEN start_day>=184 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END k,
  COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(effective_price),1) p, ROUND(SUM(effective_price),0) rev
  FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'
  GROUP BY b, k ORDER BY b, k""")
# aggregate
from collections import defaultdict
band_tot=defaultdict(lambda:[0,0.0])
bucket_band=defaultdict(lambda:defaultdict(lambda:[0,0.0]))
for row in r['rows']:
    b=row['b']; k=row['k']; n=row['n']; rev=row['rev']
    band_tot[k][0]+=n; band_tot[k][1]+=rev
    bucket_band[b][k]=[n,rev]
print("\n--- Totals by maturity band (k=rebills done) ---")
names={0:'k0 NEW(crater@1st)',1:'k1 (survived1, faces2nd)',2:'k2',3:'k3+ MATURE'}
for k in [0,1,2,3]:
    n,rev=band_tot[k]; print(f"  {names[k]:28s}: {n:>8,} subs  fullrev/mo ${rev:>12,.0f}  avg${rev/max(n,1):.1f}")
tot=sum(band_tot[k][0] for k in band_tot); print(f"  TOTAL: {tot:,} subs")

# Next 4 weeks collection projection
def surv_next(k):  # survival applied at the NEXT rebill given k rebills done
    if k==0: return 0.10   # 1st rebill craters (wk34 observed 7.9%)
    if k==1: return 0.72   # 2nd rebill
    return 0.88            # mature
print("\n--- Collection projection next 28 days (by bucket, applying next-rebill survival) ---")
wk_coll=defaultdict(float); wk_crater_coll=defaultdict(float); wk_mat_coll=defaultdict(float)
for d in range(DAY+1, DAY+29):
    b=d%30
    wk=(d-DAY-1)//7
    for k in [0,1,2,3]:
        n,rev=bucket_band[b].get(k,[0,0.0])
        if n==0: continue
        coll=rev*surv_next(k)
        wk_coll[wk]+=coll
        if k==0: wk_crater_coll[wk]+=coll
        else: wk_mat_coll[wk]+=coll
print("  wk | buckets | survivor_collect | (of which crater-1st | mature) ")
for wk in range(4):
    days=[ (DAY+1+wk*7+i)%30 for i in range(7)]
    print(f"  wk{wk+40}: buckets{days} coll=${wk_coll[wk]:>11,.0f}  crater=${wk_crater_coll[wk]:>10,.0f} mature=${wk_mat_coll[wk]:>11,.0f}")

# Bucket sizes raw (subs) for next 14 days

def run(surv1,surv2,matsurv,acq0,decay,promo=41.5,newre=47.3,
        fixed=117500.0,comp=0.477,adrev=0.105,leadpa=1.19):
    cohorts=[[r['s'],r['p'],float(r['n'])] for r in base]
    cash=cash0; acq=acq0
    cks={280:0,301:0,357:0,455:0}
    for d in range(day0+1,456):
        bucket=d%30; coll=0.0
        for c in cohorts:
            s,p,n=c
            if n<=0 or s>=d or (s%30)!=bucket: continue
            k=(d-s)//30
            if k<=0: continue
            sv = surv1 if k==1 else (surv2 if k==2 else matsurv)
            nn=n*sv; coll+=nn*p; c[2]=nn
        coll+=acq*promo
        cohorts.append([d,newre,acq])
        subs=sum(c[2] for c in cohorts if c[2]>0)
        cash += coll + subs*adrev - (fixed + subs*comp + acq*leadpa)
        acq*=decay
        if d in cks: cks[d]=cash
    return cks

# Actual payments by amount on last cycle's high-bucket days (d245-250, buckets 5-10)
r = nm.query("""SELECT day, ROUND(amount,0) amt, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(amount),0) tot
  FROM ledger WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day>=245 AND day<=250
  GROUP BY day, ROUND(amount,0) ORDER BY day, amt""")
from collections import defaultdict
fullprice={26,79,199}
day_surv=defaultdict(float); day_new=defaultdict(float)
for row in r['rows']:
    amt=row['amt']
    if amt in fullprice: day_surv[row['day']]+=row['tot']
    else: day_new[row['day']]+=row['tot']
print("  day | survivor(full) | new(promo) | total")
tot_s=0; tot_n=0
for d in sorted(set(list(day_surv)+list(day_new))):
    s=day_surv[d]; n=day_new[d]; tot_s+=s; tot_n+=n
    print(f"  d{d} b{d%30}: surv=${s:>10,.0f}  new=${n:>10,.0f}  tot=${s+n:>10,.0f}")
print(f"  --- d245-250 SURVIVOR total ${tot_s:,.0f} | NEW total ${tot_n:,.0f}")
print(f"  (these buckets 5-10; next wk40 buckets 4-10 ~ same region)")
# Compare: how many subs were ACTIVE 30d ago vs now (proxy = subs that have a payment then)
print("\n--- Mature survival check: full-price payers d245-250 vs model's wk40 survivor $4.0M ---")
print(f"  Last cycle survivor (b5-10): ${tot_s:,.0f}. 30d base decay ~12-16% -> expect ~${tot_s*0.86:,.0f}-${tot_s*0.84:,.0f} now")
